title: Efficient method for in situ agitation of liquids directly inside NMR spectrometer
author: De Souza Braga Neto, Rigaud, et al.
materials: The method proposed in this work is validated using a HLLE system. The thermomorphic ionic liquid used here is cholinium bis(trifluoromethyl-sulfonyl)imide, [Chol][TFSI]. The aqueous solution contains betaine (trimethyl-glycine). Fig. 2 presents the chemical structure of the different molecules. [Chol][TFSI] ionic liquid and water, in a mass fraction of 1:1, form a biphasic system at room temperature, and become monophasic above 72 °C, its upper critical transition temperature [12]. The betaine in this system plays the role of metal extractant. Note that for the method validation, no metal is necessary and therefore none has be introduced in the aqueous phase.Fig. 2Chemical structure of (a) [Chol][TFSI] and (b) betaine.Fig 2

steps.title: Prepare NMR tube and gas inlet/outlet
steps.instruction: Take a 10 mm outer‑diameter NMR tube, drill two holes in the cap: a ~2.5 mm hole for a Teflon tube (outer diam 3.17 mm, inner diam 1.58 mm) and a 0.5 mm hole for gas outlet; insert the Teflon tube through the larger hole and perforate it at several points within the segment that will be immersed in the ionic liquid to avoid capillary effects.

steps.title: Load phases and lock capillary
steps.instruction: Introduce into the tube in this order: (1) the densest phase, cholinium bis(trifluoromethyl‑sulfonyl)imide ([Chol][TFSI]) ionic liquid; (2) a sealed 1.7 mm‑diameter glass capillary filled with deuterium oxide for the magnetic‑field lock; (3) the aqueous phase containing betaine (trimethyl‑glycine). Use a mass‑fraction of 1:1 for [Chol][TFSI] and water, which gives a biphasic system at room temperature and becomes monophasic above 72 °C. No metal salts are added.

steps.title: Heat to 80 °C and start agitation
steps.instruction: Place the assembled tube in the NMR spectrometer, increase the temperature from room temperature to 80 °C (the set point is reached within ~15 min). As soon as 80 °C is attained, begin gas flow through the Teflon tube to agitate the sample; maintain agitation for 30 min, which yields complete phase mixing and homogenization.

steps.title: Cool back to room temperature
steps.instruction: After agitation, allow the sample to return to room temperature; observe the shift in interface height and resonance changes caused by mass transfer between the phases.
